text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that training's over, it's time for
that special
reward... Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in my morning fortune-telling
session! "A
shuttle full of sparkles." That
can only mean—
choice_data_list: Wait, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Taiki Shuttle? Oh, no, no, no! I
was—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Could this mean that Taiki is the
shuttle
that brings the sparkles?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So you want somethin' sparkly, do
ya? Then,
I got just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Great! Taiki's from the US,
so I bet it's a
great
big piggy bank full of silver
dollars!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come partner runnin' with me! Your
skin'll shine
real good with the sweat I'll
have you workin'
up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You want us to go partner running? I
guess that
would be one way to create
an abundance of
sparkles...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, haha! I'd love to, but I need my
trainer's
permission first...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Run with Taiki... or do
you
have a reward for me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Argh! I had an feeling you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru puts her all into her
extra
training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! I worked super hard today, after
all! So,
what kind of sparkly reward have
you got for
me? ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, wait just a gosh darn minute!
Didn't you say
you were going to "fill
Taiki Shuttle up with
sparkles"?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meet both their expectations by giving
them two
sparkling... cans of juice.
